notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 20 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.
Byline 'Artemis "." Entreri' is a fictional character's name (R. A. Salvatore's assassin) with handle '.', so he is credited as plain text with no player page.

Starting cards as given in the strategy: Watch Your Step, Tatooine, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Squadron Assignments, Don't Do That Again, plus 'your choice, either Menace or Aim High'; all are in the list and count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is shown as one.
Section headers ('Objective-1', 'Characters-18', ...) are not cards; the '-2' / '-3' suffixes are quantities.
